The Confucius Institute Scholarship (International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship, cis.chinese.cn; application portal chinese.cn) is a national scheme established by the Center for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC) of China's Ministry of Education. Verified via the official 2025 Application Guidelines PDF on chinese.cn (https://www.chinese.cn/uploads/file/20250212-1739354417242563.pdf): 'the Center for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC) has established the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship ... Recommending Institutions may recommend outstanding students and in-service Chinese language teachers to further their studies ... at Chinese universities (hereinafter referred to as Host Institutions)'. Awards are distributed across dozens of host universities (e.g., Nanjing University, Central South University) via recommending institutions; the scheme has no single attached institution or supervising professor, so none exists to verify.
